title: Butcher Shop, Week 8
dek: Kenneth Walker III ran for 36 yards on his usual snaps. That is the prime cut to buy this week.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Tue 8:05 PM ET: the buys and sells now give the reasons and the call, not a trade price, and each player's reasons now cover the weeks before, the injuries and who is in or out.

Updated Tue 7:45 PM ET: rest-of-season ranks refreshed throughout; the calls stand.

Updated Tue 7:35 PM ET: Jaylen Waddle has no clean bill on the chest and shoulder yet, and his Week 8 status vs KC rides on Thursday and Friday practice; he is still WR39 rest of season for me, so sell him.

Week 7 left starters with full roles and bad box scores, and handed touchdowns to backups who got the work only because someone else sat. The buys are volume waiting on a better script, a healthy quarterback or a bye to pass; the sells scored on carries or touchdowns that will not hold. Ranks are rest of season for me, PPR scoring. Houston, New Orleans, the Giants and San Francisco are on bye in Week 8, and a bye is the cheapest week to buy.

buy.why: Kenneth Walker III (KC) played 74% of the snaps at SEA, about the same share as his last two games, but ran 14 times for 36 in the 20-3 loss. Kansas City ran no plays in the red zone that night. A week earlier he ran 19 times for 128 and 2 TDs vs LAC, and his 665 rushing yards through five games were the most in NFL history for a player's first five with a new team. Rashee Rice and right tackle Jaylon Moore sat at SEA, and the trip to DEN is next.
buy.verdict: RB3 rest of season for me. Buy him while his manager stares at 36 yards.

buy.why: Matthew Golden (GB) has 25 targets over the last two weeks and drew 12 at DET with 165 air yards, on 85% of the snaps, but caught 6 for 39. He caught 6 for 104 and a TD on 13 targets vs DAL in Week 6, with two drops on potential scores. He sat out Monday's and Tuesday's walkthroughs with shoulder and foot injuries before Thursday vs CAR. Jayden Reed is out for the season after neck surgery, and Green Bay is down to its third-string center.
buy.verdict: WR14 rest of season for me, and the targets say higher. Buy him before Wednesday's final injury report.

buy.why: Derrick Henry (BAL) ran 17 times in each of the last two games and has 103 yards to show for it, on 51% of the snaps vs CIN. Tyler Huntley started at quarterback for a third straight week. Jesse Minter said Lamar Jackson is in a decent spot after three missed games, and Ian Rapoport reports he is close to 100% and on track to play at BUF. Henry ran for 301 yards and 6 TDs in the first three games of the season.
buy.verdict: RB9 rest of season for me. Buy him before Lamar Jackson is back.

buy.why: Chris Olave (NO) has drawn 23 targets over the last three games, a 26% target share vs PIT, and turned them into 145 yards and one TD. He had 36 targets in Weeks 1 to 3 and scored 15 or more PPR points in each of the first four games. He missed two practices with an illness before Week 6 and played anyway. New Orleans is on bye in Week 8, so his manager is holding a zero this week on top of three quiet box scores.
buy.verdict: WR9 rest of season for me. Buy him during the bye.

buy.why: Justin Jefferson (MIN) drew 29% of the targets vs IND and caught 4 for 44. Kyler Murray went 14 of 24 for 150 in that game. Jefferson sprained his left ankle on his seventh play at TB in Week 3, missed Week 4, and caught 6 of 7 targets for 79 and a TD in his return at NO. He was a full participant last Thursday, and Minnesota goes to DET next.
buy.verdict: WR11 rest of season for me. Buy him while the quarterback play holds his numbers down.

buy.why: Christian McCaffrey (SF) strained his hamstring early at ATL, came back, and still had 13 touches for 100 yards and a TD on 34 snaps. The strain is mild, and he is on track for Week 9 vs LV after the bye. A week earlier he had 26 opportunities vs WAS, his most of the season, with 2 rushing TDs and 9 catches. Kyle Shanahan is pretty optimistic he is fine, and Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr. are on track to return after the bye too.
buy.verdict: RB5 rest of season for me. Buy him during the bye.

buy.why: Chase Brown (CIN) played 75% of the snaps at BAL and had 15 touches, but ran 11 times for 39, and Tennessee comes to Cincinnati Sunday. Joe Burrow threw 4 TDs in the 35-13 win. In Week 5 at MIA, Brown ran 13 times for 38 and lost a red-zone fumble, the first game this season he did not lead Cincinnati in carries. Samaje Perine took the 1-yard TD at BAL, and Dan Pitcher has said the staff will keep assessing the touch share between the two backs.
buy.verdict: RB16 rest of season for me. Buy him before he plays TEN.

buy.why: Tetairoa McMillan (CAR) drew 15 targets over Weeks 6 and 7 and caught 4 for 40 in the 43-13 loss to TB. Bryce Young was pulled early in the fourth quarter with Carolina down 43-6. McMillan caught 14 of 16 targets for 192 and 2 TDs vs DET in Week 4. Young was a full participant on Monday's and Tuesday's estimated reports before Thursday at GB, and Jalen Coker was full Tuesday with the shoulder.
buy.verdict: WR15 rest of season for me. Buy him before Thursday at GB.

buy.why: Ashton Jeanty (LV) was back up to 72% of the snaps vs LAR after 53% and 58%, and caught 8 of 8 targets for 61 and a TD. He ran 8 times for 15 because Las Vegas trailed. Mike Washington Jr. played 18 snaps after taking half the early downs in Week 6. Jeanty's ankle and foot cut into his snaps in Weeks 4 and 5, and he has run for 27 yards or fewer in three straight games.
buy.verdict: RB13 rest of season for me. Buy him while his rushing yards look ugly.

buy.why: Brock Purdy (SF) threw 40 times at ATL, a season high, for 288 yards, a TD and 2 interceptions in San Francisco's first loss. He had 9 TD passes through Week 3, tied for the league lead. Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr. both sat at ATL, and both are on track to return after the bye. San Francisco is on bye in Week 8 and hosts LV in Week 9.
buy.verdict: QB3 rest of season for me. Buy him during the bye.

buy.why: Patrick Mahomes II (KC) has no TD pass in two straight games on 63 attempts, and went 19 of 33 for 165 at SEA. He went 23 of 30 for 272 vs LAC the week before, so the attempts held and the touchdowns are what is missing. Rashee Rice and right tackle Jaylon Moore sat Sunday night, and left tackle Josh Simmons is on IR. Tyquan Thornton is out 12 to 16 weeks after ankle surgery.
buy.verdict: QB12 rest of season for me. Buy him at the low point.

buy.why: George Kittle (SF) caught 8 of 10 targets for 88 at ATL and has played 85% of the snaps or more in five straight games, with 24 targets over the last three. He caught 5 for 69 and a TD vs WAS in Week 6. Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr. both missed the ATL game, and both are on track to return after the bye. San Francisco's Week 8 bye is the only discount you will get.
buy.verdict: TE3 rest of season for me. Buy him during the bye.

sell.why: Tony Pollard (TEN) ran 25 times for 129 and 3 TDs vs CLE on 75 percent of the snaps, with Tyjae Spears and Nick Singleton both inactive. He had 14 and 19 carries the two weeks before. Spears (knee) out-snapped him in Week 5, and his return puts Pollard back on his early-season share. Tennessee is 1-6.
sell.verdict: RB24 rest of season for me. Sell him on the three scores.

sell.why: Javonte Williams (DAL) ran 25 times for 155 and a TD in the 38-21 win at PHI, his third straight game with a score. He had 0 targets Monday and 5 over the last three games, and Hunter Luepke took more of the third-down work. In the two games before, he ran 12 times for 45 vs TB and 11 times for 41 at GB, with Dallas held to 50 and 48 rushing yards.
sell.verdict: RB8 rest of season for me. Sell him while the carries and scores are at their peak.

sell.why: Tee Higgins (CIN) caught 6 of 7 targets for 148 and a TD at BAL. Ja'Marr Chase also drew 7 targets on the same 46 snaps. Higgins strained an adductor late in his 11-catch, 157-yard game vs JAX in Week 4. He then missed two practices with the groin and neck and drew 4 targets at MIA, his game before Sunday.
sell.verdict: WR16 rest of season for me. Sell him on the 148 yards.

sell.why: Jameson Williams (DET) caught 5 of 9 targets for 91 and 2 TDs vs GB, 29 percent of the throws, after 4, 8 and 4 targets in his three games before. Amon-Ra St. Brown drew 11 targets and is due back at practice Thursday after tweaking an ankle. Jahmyr Gibbs played a season-high 90 percent of the snaps. Williams' 2025 surge came after Sam LaPorta went down and Dan Campbell took over play-calling, and LaPorta is on the field this season.
sell.verdict: WR23 rest of season for me. Sell him on the two scores.

sell.why: Christian Watson (GB) has drawn 8 targets in each of his last three games, his share fell from 26 percent to 19, and he scored in four of his first five games. Matthew Golden drew 13 and 12 targets the last two games. Josh Jacobs is back and caught 5 passes in his first game. Watson played through an ankle that limited him in practice last week, and Green Bay hosts CAR on Thursday with its third-string center after Sean Rhyan's high ankle sprain.
sell.verdict: WR10 rest of season for me. Sell him before Thursday vs CAR.

sell.why: Emanuel Wilson (SEA) ran 24 times for 100 and a TD vs KC on 48 percent of the snaps, with Zach Charbonnet inactive. A week earlier at DEN, George Holani out-snapped him and Wilson ran 14 times for 52 on 32 percent of the snaps. Charbonnet, off PUP since Oct 22, sat Week 7 with no setback per Mike Macdonald and is eyed for Monday vs CHI. Jadarian Price is set to open his 21-day practice window off IR this week, and Seattle added Quenton Nelson from Indianapolis.
sell.verdict: RB47 rest of season for me. Sell him while the 100 yards are fresh.

sell.why: Woody Marks (HOU) played 54 of 61 snaps vs NYG and ran 19 times for 66, the only Houston back with a touch. He ran 15 times for 62 at TEN and 15 for 56 at JAX after David Montgomery hurt his groin in Week 5. Before that injury, Marks played 20 snaps in each of Weeks 3 and 4 behind Montgomery. Houston is on bye in Week 8, and Montgomery has two weeks to heal the groin and take early downs back.
sell.verdict: RB30 rest of season for me. Sell him during the bye.

sell.why: Jaylen Waddle (DEN) played a season-low 56 percent of the snaps at ARI and caught 4 for 48, then left late in the fourth quarter with chest and left shoulder injuries. No clean bill has been reported, and his Week 8 status vs KC depends on Thursday and Friday practice. He has not topped 48 yards in a game since Week 2, and he also hurt the shoulder before halftime in Week 6 vs SEA. Since Sean Payton took play-calling back in Week 5, Waddle caught 2 of 5 for 19 at LAC and 4 of 7 for 24 vs SEA.
sell.verdict: WR39 rest of season for me. Sell him before Friday's injury report.

sell.why: Caleb Douglas (MIA) caught 2 of 3 targets for 70 and 2 TDs at NYJ in his first game since Week 2, on 68 percent of the snaps and 14 percent of the targets. His two scores went for 7 and 63 yards after an ankle injury cost him Weeks 3 to 5. Malik Willis threw 21 passes. Ollie Gordon II carried 25 times, and Jeff Hafley has said the plan to emphasize the run does not change.
sell.verdict: WR52 rest of season for me. Sell him to the manager who claimed him.

sell.why: Geno Smith (NYJ) went 23 of 30 for 287 and 3 TDs vs MIA after 3 TD passes over his previous three games. He has thrown exactly 30 times in each of his last three, and the Jets ran 32 plays in Week 4 at CHI. Garrett Wilson drew 3 targets Sunday, and his share fell from 38 percent in Week 5 to 10 percent with Omar Cooper Jr. back. Breece Hall is targeting a Week 8 return vs LV after missing four games with the quad.
sell.verdict: QB24 rest of season for me. Sell him after the three-TD week.

sell.why: Malik Willis (MIA) went 14 of 21 for 208 and 2 TDs at NYJ and ran 8 times for 37 and a TD in Miami's first win. Ollie Gordon II carried 25 times as the lead back. In Week 3 vs KC, Willis went 20 of 36 for 210 with no TD and an interception. Miami scored 13, 13 and 10 points in its first three games.
sell.verdict: QB21 rest of season for me. Sell him on the first win.

sell.why: Mason Taylor (NYJ) caught 5 of 6 targets for 62 and 2 TDs vs MIA, his first touchdowns of the season. He has drawn 6 targets in each of the last two games after a thumb injury cost him Weeks 3 and 4. He ran 70 percent of the routes at NE in Week 6. Omar Cooper Jr. is back to take the middle of the field, with 5 catches for 115 and a TD Sunday.
sell.verdict: TE31 rest of season for me. Sell him on the two scores.
